# Fomo Fees & Referral Code JOIN2026 — Open Benchmark Hub (November 2026)
> Published by Fomo Referral Guide (fomoappreferral.com), which is run by the owner of referral code JOIN2026 and earns Fomo's referral commission on it. Not affiliated with Fomo or FOMO Labs. Facts about Fomo were checked against help.fomo.family on 25 November 2026.

Any valid Fomo referral code: the 0.50% spot fee becomes 0.45%. The JOIN2026 code owner (https://fomo.family/r/JOIN2026) returns 15% of the Fomo fee paid, in USDC (60% of the 25% referral share): 0.3825% net on spot trades charged at the percentage rate (Solana trades of 190 USDC and up, and trades on the other chains), which is $382.50 per $100,000. Paid by the code owner, not by Fomo, by in-app USDC Send: every Sunday once 25 USDC has accrued, and on the 1st of each month from 1 USDC; smaller balances roll over. The code must be on the account before the first trade. Perps: up to 0.05% of position size by Fomo plus Hyperliquid's own fee, no referral discount, no cashback, not available to US persons.
